title: Prepare annual sustainability (climate) reports
what: An entity that must prepare a financial report and meets the size or emissions tests must prepare an annual sustainability report under the climate disclosure standards.

sources.title: Corporations Act 2001
sources.quote: 292A Who has to prepare annual sustainability reports (1) Subject to subsection (2), an entity must prepare a sustainability report for a financial year if:
